:::{#def-surprisal-continuous}
#### Surprisal of a value of a continuous random variable

The **surprisal** of a possible value $x$ of a
[continuous random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-continuous-rv) $X$
with [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) $f$
and $f(x) > 0$ is

$$s(x) \eqdef -\log f(x).$$

This extends the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of a value of a discrete random variable,
with the density $f(x)$ in place of the probability $\P(X=x)$.

:::
